sourceProvenance.title: Escravos de Jo
sourceProvenance.edition: AllgoCoast transcription of the traditional Brazilian melody, published on Wikimedia Commons in 2005/2006; printed repeats and endings realized linearly; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (score transcription); traditional melody public domain
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.
sourceProvenance.attribution: Score transcription by AllgoCoast, CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL 1.2+, via Wikimedia Commons; Pianify changes: deterministic MIDI realization and original left-hand harmonization

derivation.melody: manual transcription of the public-domain historical staff, preserving printed pitch and rhythm
derivation.harmony: Pianify editorial piano harmonization v1, clearly separated from the licensed source melody
